frequency_question: What proportion of formal recognition-stripping processes against major accreditors proceed to final revocation within a two-year observation window once initial warning signals appear?
membership_rule: Includes any federal Department of Education or equivalent oversight body proceeding against a federally recognized national/professional accrediting agency resulting in complete loss of recognition. Excludes voluntary relinquishments or minor probationary warnings that do not reach the formal revocation stage.

coverage_note: 3 named major challenges; 1 completed revocation, 2 survived with modifications.
known_gaps: Excludes minor programmatic accreditors of tiny sub-specialties where federal stakes are negligible.
skeleton: Total major recognized accreditor formal termination challenges initiated by federal oversight since 1990 vs those resulting in final revocation.
multiplier: 1 final revocation (ACICS) out of roughly 3 formal high-level challenges mounted against major national/professional accreditors over 34 years.
validity_reason: Statutory frameworks governing federal recognition of accreditors under the Higher Education Act remain stable across multiple presidential administrations.
